title: Preparing Students for the World of Work
text: The Training & Placement Cell runs aptitude and soft-skills training, arranges internships and organises campus recruitment drives for final-year students.

process.title: Registration
process.text: Final-year students register with the T&P Cell.

process.title: Pre-placement talks
process.text: Companies present roles, packages and selection rounds.

process.title: Offer & onboarding
process.text: Offer letters issued and joining formalities completed.

training.title: Aptitude & reasoning
training.text: Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning and verbal ability, practised through timed tests in the format recruiters use.

training.title: Communication & soft skills
training.text: Group discussions, presentations and workplace communication.

training.title: Technical interview prep
training.text: Core subject revision, coding practice and mock technical interviews.

training.title: Internships
training.text: Short industry placements that put classroom learning to work.

training.title: Career guidance
training.text: One-to-one advice on jobs, higher studies and competitive exams.

training.title: Certifications
training.text: Industry-recognised certifications that strengthen a resume.
